evals.prompt: Review this dbt model that joins orders to payments and is incremental on created_at.
evals.expected_output: Flags fan-out from the payments join, missing unique_key, strict incremental filter dropping late data, and missing tests; gives fixes and a verify command.
expectations: Identifies join fan-out and aggregating first
Recommends a lookback for late data
Adds unique/not_null tests on the PK

evals.prompt: Just add select distinct at the end to fix the duplicate rows.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on DISTINCT and finds the cause of duplicates (fan-out or source duplicates) instead.
expectations: Does not recommend DISTINCT as the fix

evals.prompt: Should I put the customer lifetime value calculation in stg_customers?
evals.expected_output: Explains staging is for rename/cast only and puts business logic in an intermediate or mart model.
expectations: Recommends an int_ or mart model for the logic
